autoContext: Validates scramda2 action. Covers: prompt param (string with {variable} template substitution via _SafeMap), includedData param (controls which keys are available for substitution), examples param (array of {question, answer} training pairs passed to service — empty array is valid), model param (optional model override string). NOTE: this workflow requires the SCRAMDA service to be running. Run with: clay run workflows/test/test-scramda2.json

test_prompt_substitution._comment: PARAM: prompt — string template. {topic} and {audience} are substituted from includedData. Unknown {vars} are preserved literally (SafeMap). PARAM: includedData — filters which previous_data keys are passed to the handler.
test_prompt_substitution.prompt: In one sentence, describe what {topic} means to {audience}.

test_empty_examples._comment: PARAM: examples — array of {question, answer} objects. Empty array is valid and sends no training signal. Omitting 'examples' entirely is also valid (defaults to []).
test_empty_examples.prompt: List three benefits of {topic} in one sentence each.

test_model_override._comment: PARAM: model — optional string to override the model used for this specific action. When omitted, the workflow-level model or caller's model is used.
